transcript.message: Thanks for calling Riverbend Physical Therapy, this is Maya on the new-patient line. If this is a medical emergency, please hang up and call 911. How can I help you today?
Hi, yeah, I'm calling to set up an appointment as a new patient. I've been having lower back pain for like two months now.
Thanks for calling, I can help you get that set up. Before we go further, have you had any numbness, tingling, weakness in your legs, or any loss of bladder or bowel control?
No, nothing like that. It's just this dull ache in my lower back, no injury or anything.
Thank you, I'm glad to hear that. What's the best callback phone number for you, with the area code?
Let me make sure I have that right: 713-555-0102. Is that correct?
Yeah, that's right.
Thank you. What's your ZIP code or city?
It's 77401, I'm in Bellaire.
Thanks, I have Bellaire. Who is your insurance plan with, and is this a work injury?
No, not a work injury. I have BayouCare HMO, member ID is BC-77310.

transcript.message: Thanks for calling Riverbend Physical Therapy, this is Maya on the new-patient line. If this is a medical emergency, please hang up and call 911. How can I help you today?
Hey yeah, hi. I'm calling because I filled out a form on your website about a week ago and never heard back. I've got shoulder pain and I'm trying to get an appointment.
I'm sorry you didn't hear back after filling out the form, and I'd be glad to help get you scheduled. Can you tell me a bit more about the shoulder pain, like which shoulder and since when?
It's my right shoulder, been bugging me for about a month. Reaching overhead is the worst part.
Thanks for explaining that. Has there been any numbness, weakness, or tingling in your arm or hand, or any chest pain or trouble breathing?
Uh, no, none of that. Just the shoulder pain when I lift my arm up.
Thank you, that helps. What's the best callback number for you, with the area code?
Let me read that back to you: seven, one, three, five, five, five, zero, one, four, four. Is that correct?
Yeah, that's right.
Thank you. What's your ZIP code or city?
Thanks. Who is your insurance plan with, and do you have your member ID handy? If you don't have insurance, just let me know.
It's Lone Star Health, PPO plan. Member ID is LS-88120.
Thanks. Is this shoulder pain related to a work injury?
No, nothing like that. Just kind of came on gradually.

transcript.message: Thanks for calling Riverbend Physical Therapy, this is Maya on the new-patient line. If this is a medical emergency, please hang up and call 911. How can I help you today?

Gracias por contármelo, Marisol. Lo siento mucho que lleve un mes con ese dolor. ¿Me puede dar su número de teléfono de contacto, de diez dígitos?
Gracias, Marisol. Tengo el número 713 555 0111. ¿Es correcto?
Sí, ese es.
Perfecto, gracias. ¿Me puede decir su código postal o la ciudad donde vive?
77506, soy de Pasadena.
Gracias, Marisol. ¿Qué seguro médico tiene, y si lo tiene, me puede dar el número de miembro? Si no tiene seguro, también me lo puede decir.
Tengo Gulf Coast Medicare Advantage. No sé el número de miembro ahorita, no lo traigo aquí.

5 de mayo de 1958.
Entonces, Marisol Vega, con la clínica de Pasadena, el lunes 2 de noviembre a las 8:00 de la mañana, con la terapeuta Carmen Ruiz. ¿Es correcto? Si me dice que sí, lo reservo.
